Where you land

What opens when you launch ArticleFlux fresh — a bookmark, a home-screen icon, a new browser profile.
Resumes where you left off by default. Pick a stream, a feed, a tag or a folder to always open there instead.
◈

What the list shows

ArticlesWhether the list hides what you have already read.
Feeds in the sidebarOn a long list, most feeds did not publish today.
✓

What counts as read

Mark readReaching the end of an article marks it, as does clicking in it. Turn this off to mark only what you deliberately open.
Marking everything read in bulk never counts against a feed's ranking — giving up on a backlog is not a verdict on the publisher.
▤

Slideshow

One story at a time, filling the screen, advancing by itself. Press s, or use the button beside Mark all read.
How long each story stays upAutomatic gives each story the time it takes to read — between 20 seconds and a minute, depending on its length.
